Step-by-Step Audio Guided Tour: restaurant tour of Boston Sail Loft, Boston, MA
Tour-Category: restaurant

Stop 1: Boston Sail Loft

Coordinates: 42.3545, -71.0505

Orientation: You are about to embark on a walking journey through Boston Sail Loft, Boston, MA. As you arrive at this renowned seafood restaurant located in the North End Waterfront, established in 1984, you'll be immersed in the legacy of New England's maritime traditions. The Boston Sail Loft, since 1984, has been a go-to spot for classic New England seafood, offering fantastic Boston Harbor views. Your first stop is Boston Sail Loft. Position yourself to best view this location.

The Boston Sail Loft, perched along Atlantic Avenue since 1984, is a beloved staple of Boston's North End waterfront. The restaurant has carved out a niche with its unique charm and hearty dishes. Today, the restaurant's back section is a nod to this heritage, partially cantilevered over the harbor on wooden pilings, offering diners a literal taste of the ocean's embrace. One of the culinary highlights here is the clam chowder, which the Boston Sail Loft has famously infused with fresh dill. What's more, the chowder is served in an enormous coffee mug filled past the brim, challenging the waitstaff with its precarious balance and delighting patrons with its generous portion. Upon entering, the Boston Sail Loft exudes a cozy ambiance reminiscent of a nautical dive-bar-meets-seafood-joint. Reservations are not required here; the restaurant operates on a 'first come, first served' basis, fostering a laid-back and inclusive environment. Situated in a prime location, the Boston Sail Loft not only serves delectable food but also provides breathtaking views of Boston Harbor, creating an ideal setting to relax and savor a traditional New England meal. The Boston Sail Loft is open from 11:30 am to 2:00 am on Monday and Tuesday. They offer their famed clam chowder for $6.50 a cup or $7.25 a bowl, with lobster rolls also available.
